data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Alaina, which means ‘shining light’ or ‘gentle one’. In Greek mythology, Alaina was a nymph associated with the sun and the goddess Aphrodite. The name Allayne carries the meaning “Gentle, Bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Allayne usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Allayne total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
